Reservoir expands copyright lawsuits against Suno and Anthropic to more than 2,500 songs combined
Peanuts music catalog owner settles copyright lawsuit against GameMill over Snoopy video game soundtrack
items.summary: GameMill licensed the Peanuts characters but not Vince Guaraldi’s music, then copied Linus and Lucy and Skating, the complaint alleged. Source

items.title: Suno Bridge takes AI music to DAWs – starting with Ableton Live
items.summary: Suno building a bridge? No, this isn’t news of a licensing deal with any of the AI-music firm’s current litigants. Instead, it’s the latest step in the company’s efforts to position itself as a legitimate music-making tool for professionals. The post is from Music Ally .

items.title: Samantha Saturn appointed General Manager of ASCAP Nashville
items.summary: The appointment takes effect on December 1, with Saturn filling a newly created role at the US performing rights organization. Source

items.title: Suno boss talks streaming fraud: ‘AI music is not a crime’
items.summary: Suno CEO Mikey Shulman has criticised what he describes as a “sleight of hand” of “equating streaming fraud with AI music”, while stressing that his company is doing more work behind the scenes to tackle fraud than people realise. The post is from Music Ally .

tip.title: Antes de firmar, revisa la reversión de derechos
tip.body: La pregunta clave de cualquier contrato no es cuánto te dan hoy, sino cuándo y cómo recuperas tu obra. Si no hay cláusula de reversión, estás cediendo por el plazo completo.

tip.title: Before signing, check the reversion clause
tip.body: The key question in any deal isn't what you get today —it's when and how you get your work back. With no reversion clause, you're assigning for the full term.
